en: Dependent on an internal state, an external state arises by way of root condition: one.
Dependent on an external state, an internal state arises by way of root condition: one. (Abbreviated.
Under root [condition] there are two; ... pe ... under non-disappearance [condition] there are two.
Dependent on a state with an internal object, a state with an internal object arises by way of root condition … two.
Dependent on a state with an external object, a state with an external object arises by way of root condition … two.
Dependent on a state with both an internal and an external object, a state with an internal object arises by way of root condition … two. (Abbreviated.)

In the case of root condition, there are six; in object condition, six; in predominance condition, two ... pe ... in prenascence and repetition conditions, two ... pe ... in non-disappearance condition, six.
